edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], using the caller as spender key.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external call.
onlyOwner gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the reentrant receiveApproval callback.
The owner identity derived from msg.sender authorizes the external rescue transfer.
